     ASD’s ACSC and co-authors recommend that organisations consider implementing user and entity
     behavioural analytics capabilities to enable automated detection of behavioural anomalies on
     networks, devices, or accounts. SIEMs can detect anomalous activity by comparing event logs to a
     baseline of business-as-usual traffic and activity. Behavioural analytics plays a key role in detecting
     malicious actors employing LOTL techniques. Below is a case study that shows how threat actors
